en.io: Input: task path or slug, optional handoff package, session/phase/resume/review-mode flags, and operational commit/branch/push arguments. Output: project changes, review verdicts, quality-gate results, commits or deferred queue state, progress metadata, memory artifacts, and audit/deploy prompts.
en.boundary: Acts only on authored Hyperflow plans and project files. It does not deploy automatically without the documented end gate or handoff disposition. Security violations halt execution; unresolved worker or gate failures can leave partial task status and changes. Correct behavior depends on referenced Hyperflow files not included in this evidence.
dependencies: Claude Code Agent, Skill, and AskUserQuestion capabilities
Hyperflow scripts and referenced prompt/policy files
Project lint, typecheck, and test tools when configured
Optional GitHub CLI for GitHub-native flows
scenarios: Run batches from a generated .hyperflow task file.
Resume execution from a selected batch or run only final integration review.
Build a multi-phase feature sequentially or one phase at a time.
Rehydrate and execute a second-session handoff package.

zh.io: 输入：任务路径或 slug、可选交接包、会话/阶段/恢复/审查模式参数，以及提交、分支、推送参数。输出：项目改动、审查结论、质量门禁结果、提交或延迟队列状态、进度元数据、记忆制品，以及审计/部署询问。
zh.boundary: 仅依据已编写的 Hyperflow 计划操作项目文件。没有文档规定的结束门禁或交接处置时不会自动部署。安全违规会中止执行；未解决的代理或门禁失败可能留下部分状态和改动。完整行为依赖本证据未附带的 Hyperflow 引用文件。
dependencies: Claude Code 的 Agent、Skill 和 AskUserQuestion 能力
Hyperflow 脚本及引用的提示词/策略文件
项目已配置的 lint、类型检查和测试工具
GitHub 原生流程可选依赖 GitHub CLI
scenarios: 执行 .hyperflow 任务文件中的批次。
从指定批次恢复，或只运行最终集成审查。
连续构建多阶段功能，或一次只构建一个阶段。
还原并执行第二会话的交接包。
